thread:
frank-finance: FYI invoice from Sven/@AlpineTech billed to Redwood NL BV. Vendor attached a W-9 and applied 0% VAT but also asked us to gross-up for a 10% withholding they claim applies. Invoice missing their Swiss VAT ID. Hold payment until we sort tax docs.

nora-legal: Quick check 1; W-9 is US only, not relevant. For Swiss vendors billing an EU entity we need CFR and vendor VAT or local tax reg number. Also clarify whether the supply is subject to reverse-charge VAT (usually for B2B services) or withholding.

mike-procure: PO #9202. If vendor wants gross-up that increases our committed spend; will need procurement + finance approval. What's the vendor's reasoning for claiming WHT?

sven-vendor: Hi team 1; Sven here. Our Swiss advisor suggested a 10% withholding when invoicing EU customers outside of Switzerland. We provided a W-9 by mistake 1; apologies. We can send a Certificate of Fiscal Residence (CFR) and our Swiss VAT ID. We prefer gross-up to avoid receiving less net.

frank-finance: Please send CFR + Swiss tax/VAT ID. Also confirm whether you have a Netherlands VAT registration or are treating this as B2B export of services. For NL entity, reverse-charge may apply and then no VAT charged by vendor. Withholding (WHT) is separate and depends on domestic rules/treaty.

nora-legal: I'll check NL domestic rules vs Swiss TA. Many consultancy/service fees are taxed in the resident country unless a PE exists. If no PE in NL, treaty may prevent source WHT. Send CFR and invoice showing gross/net/WHT lines so we can assess.

tax-bot: Reminder: W-8/W-9 documents are for US tax reporting. For non-US cross-border EU invoices, required docs typically: Certificate of Fiscal Residence, vendor tax registration number, and clear invoice line items. For VAT: determine if reverse-charge applies (buyer liable) or vendor must charge VAT.

mike-procure: Action: hold payment, ask vendor for CFR + updated invoice + bank details. If vendor insists on gross-up, procurement to estimate delta and route approvals.

sven-vendor: Sent CFR and invoice v2 to finance@redwood.com. Invoice v2 line: "Service fee 22,000 EUR - Withholding requested 2,200 EUR (10%) - Net 19,800 EUR". Also added Swiss VAT ID and note about not having NL VAT registration.

frank-finance: Received. Forwarding to legal/tax. If reverse-charge applies and we are liable for VAT, vendor shouldn't withhold. If treaty says no WHT, we will not withhold. If vendor still requests gross-up, we'll need PO amendment.

nora-legal: Reviewing treaty and NL domestic WHT rules now. If no PE and treaty shields services, we should apply 0% WHT; vendor can claim relief. Will confirm by EOD.

tax-bot: Checklist updated: [CFR received, vendor tax id, updated invoice with WHT line, legal treaty confirmation, PO amendment if gross-up].
